question: Tell me about yourself and your professional background.
description: Standard opening question to assess communication and self-awareness.
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates candidate's ability to present a concise, relevant professional narrative.
exampleAnswer: I am currently a junior software engineer at TechSolutions with two years of experience in full-stack development. I started as an intern during my final year of engineering, where I worked on a customer-facing dashboard. After graduation, I joined as a full-time developer. My focus has been on building scalable web applications and improving development workflows. Looking ahead, I want to take on more system design responsibilities and contribute to architecture decisions.
evaluationCriteria: Clarity of narrative, relevance to role, professional tone, time management (under 2 minutes)
followUpQuestions: Why are you interested in this role specifically?
What is your most significant professional achievement so far?
Where do you see yourself in 3-5 years?
